change_summary: The paper has been withdrawn at the editor's request, and its full text was replaced by a withdrawal statement. The statement says the indoor temperature records had been processed with an incorrect sensor calibration, so the reported results cannot be relied on. The stored copy reported a 2.1 °C lower peak indoor temperature in green-roofed flats, a result that rests on those records.
evaluation: Your draft cites Okafor et al. [14] in Section 2.2 as the source of the 2.1 °C green-roof parameter, and in the Discussion says the green-roof result scales almost directly with that value. The paper has been withdrawn, and its statement says the indoor temperature records used an incorrect sensor calibration, so the reported results cannot be relied on. Both uses rest on that indoor temperature result, so the impact is high: your central green-roof estimate depends on it.
recommendation: Stop and raise this with your co-authors or supervisor, because the withdrawal statement says the indoor temperature records were processed with an incorrect sensor calibration, and your model sets the green-roof effect to the 2.1 °C taken from that paper. Then replace the citation and re-check the Discussion, whose green-roof result scales almost directly with that value.
